summary: Stale text in the unreleased CHANGELOG and help: (1) CHANGELOG.md 'Two more rulings of the ATIP author' says L2.idempotency leaves the paths of allowedEffects out with no effectNote condition; the 'Review of checker.md 1.3.1' bullet below it corrects it, so the section contradicts itself; (2) crates/atip-check/src/l2/glob.rs:3 says 'The checker does not fix a glob syntax' while checker.md 1.3.1 fixes it; (3) `atip check --help` (cli.rs) describes allowedEffects only for reads and omits its use in L2.idempotency, and --contract lists 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 where checker.md lists 1.3 too (canon claims 1.2; a 1.3 claim is FIXTURE_INVALID, an ATIP-feedback point). Fix the three lines.
